svg.text: DECELERATION LANE → (40 m taper + 46 m parallel, indicative)
CENTRAL RESERVE WITH SAFETY BARRIER — NO MEDIAN CROSSING AT SITE
M4 INTERSTATE HIGHWAY (Yerevan – Sevan) — generic 2×2 divided cross-section, 90 km/h
LONG-VEHICLE BAY 18 × 3.2 m (minibus / camper / coach drop-off)
Planting — native steppe grasses, apricot trees
Highway drive-thru prototype — concept design (RIBA Stage 2)
Scale 1:200 @ A1 · dimensions in metres unless noted
Site geometry is a generic M4 roadside parcel; adapt to
topographic survey, title plan and Roads Dept. junction approval.
1. Right-in / right-out access from the near carriageway only; the central
barrier prevents left turns. Opposite-direction customers reach the site via
the nearest grade-separated junction / U-turn (see location study).
2. Auxiliary lane lengths are indicative for 90 km/h and must be confirmed
against Armenian road design norms and the Roads Department connection permit.
3. Building set back ≥ 20 m from the carriageway edge; confirm the statutory
roadside protection strip for interstate roads.
4. Utilities indicative: highway parcels typically lack sewer — allow for
package treatment plant or sealed tank, borehole or community water, 0.4 kV
